witness.branch: Center-lane travel before a left turn from the highway
witness.quote: A vehicle must not travel more than 200 feet in a center turn lane before making a left-hand turn from the highway.
witness.reason: The fixed center-turn lane and left-turn intent support an active departure-turn setup.

Ego travels within that lane before turning left from the highway.
